_comment: REAL PAYLOADS — captured from the owner of Pickle & Pitch Club,
KEY FINDING: KheloMore, District and Hudle do NOT fire partner-app push
notifications. They send WhatsApp Business messages to the owner. The
Android listener therefore sees them under package com.whatsapp, with the
sender name as the notification title and the message as the body — which
is why channel is "notification" here even though the transport is WhatsApp.
Playo is reported to notify by email instead; that payload is not captured yet.
expect{} is intentionally near-empty: no current template reads these. Fill
each one in by hand from the raw text, then make the template match it.
